title: Fix configuration package import label translation collisions
summary: Configuration package import methods in codeunit 8614 now share global label variables instead of declaring duplicate local ones, resolving translation ID collisions during compilation.
key_points: Moved PackageImportStartMsg and PackageImportFinishMsg labels from local method declarations to global codeunit variables
Both native XML and obsolete DotNet overloads of ImportPackageXMLDocument reference the same shared labels
Fixes AL0570 compiler diagnostic for duplicate translation IDs in LCG generation
No runtime behavior or telemetry changes; execution logic and locked status preserved
Internal validation blocker fix with no public API impact
